title: Die Hard Trilogy (USA v1.000): cartridge-address waits
summary: Preserve the inherited forced-ready workaround in all six disc executables.
rationale: Replace all eighteen statically identified cartridge-address waits with the inherited ready result. Preserve AND/TST/BT and other CPU state; intended synchronization, timing, audio and physical behavior remain unqualified. See doc/OCTOBER-REVISION-PROFILES.md.

writes.effect: Supply bit2 ready in 0.BIN;1 at file offset0x4C7EA.
writes.reason: Replace the erroneous MOV.W @R1,R0; retain the following AND #4,R0, TST R0,R0 and BT. The inherited FF byte forces the same successful condition.
